# package mbtcp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus-trace/mbtcp"
```

Package mbtcp frames Modbus/TCP: it cuts MBAP ADUs out of one direction's reassembled byte stream, survives gaps and garbage with a bounded resync, and decides which endpoint of a connection is the server.

MBAP header: transaction ID (2 bytes), protocol ID (2, 0 for Modbus), length (2: unit ID + PDU, 2..254), unit ID (1). An ADU is at most 260 bytes. TCP segment boundaries are never message boundaries.

### func ValueAt

```go
func ValueAt(req, resp []byte, addr uint16) (v uint16, ok bool)
```

ValueAt returns the raw value at a zero-based address from a read response and its request: a register word (FC03/04/23) or a bit as 0/1 (FC01/02). ok is false when the response does not hold the address.


#### func (Framer) Close

```go
func (f *Framer) Close()
```

Close reports bytes left at the end of the stream.

#### func (Framer) Gap

```go
func (f *Framer) Gap(pos uint64, n int64, exact bool)
```

Gap reports n missing bytes at pos. exact is true when only the snap length cut them (the count is certain and nothing else is missing): an ADU cut that way is reported Truncated and framing stays in sync when the cut ends inside it. Any other gap starts a resync.

#### func (Framer) Write

```go
func (f *Framer) Write(pos uint64, b []byte)
```

Write appends the stream bytes at pos (contiguous with the last call or gap) and frames what it can. A midstream stream is tried at its first byte before any resync.
